items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: an etale morphism X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S is locally quasi-finite (source lines 7977-7980). The proof unfolds the definition of etaleness for algebraic spaces through a source-and-target presentation, obtains a scheme morphism h which is etale, applies the scheme statement that an etale morphism is locally quasi-finite, and reads local quasi-finiteness back for X -> Y by definition.
